summary: Bafwasende territory (Tshopo) lies on the RN4 between Kisangani and Nia-Nia, a forest and artisanal gold-mining area away from the main eastern frontlines. No armed group is known to hold or administer any town as of 2026; the PNC is assessed as controller of Bafwasende town and the secteurs of Bafwasende, Bafwagbogbo and Opienge, with FARDC detachments at the chief-town and around mining areas. Mai-Mai Simba poacher/miner groups operating from the Okapi reserve and Maiko park forests raid mining sites and villages, especially in the east (Avakubi/Bafwanduo) and in Opienge secteur. Web research was unavailable for this run, so confidence is medium for the town and low elsewhere.

new_entities.name: Mai-Mai Simba (Mambasa/Bafwasende)
new_entities.description: Fragmented Mai-Mai Simba groups (successors of Paul Sadala 'Morgan' and 'Manu'/Lumumba factions) engaged in poaching, illegal gold mining and raids in and around the Okapi Wildlife Reserve and Maiko park (Mambasa, Bafwasende).

zones.description: Bafwasende town (territorial seat on the RN4 Kisangani-Nia-Nia road, Kenge health area)
zones.evidence: Chief-town of the territory with territorial administration, PNC commissariat and FARDC elements; Mai-Mai Simba bands active in the surrounding forests and mining areas have not been reported holding the town. Not verified against 2026 reporting: web research was unavailable for this run (search budget exhausted, search engines and news sites egress-blocked).

zones.description: Bafwasende secteur villages along the RN4 west and east of the town (Belika, Bafwabalinga, Boyulu, Bafwazana, Bafwandambo, Bafwabianga health areas) and Pumuzika (Tshopo HZ)
zones.evidence: Roadside villages on the Kisangani-Bafwasende RN4 with state police/administration and no known armed-group control; banditry and poaching occur in the forest. Not verified against 2026 reporting: web research was unavailable for this run (search budget exhausted, search engines and news sites egress-blocked).

zones.description: Eastern Bafwasende secteur toward Nia-Nia and the Ituri border (Bafwanduo health area: Bafwanduo, Avakubi, PK 300 Badumbu)
zones.evidence: Villages on the RN4 and Ituri river (Avakubi) near the Mambasa/Okapi reserve border, an area where Mai-Mai Simba poacher/gold-mining groups have historically raided mining sites; no report known of armed-group administration of the villages. Not verified against 2026 reporting: web research was unavailable for this run (search budget exhausted, search engines and news sites egress-blocked).

zones.description: Bafwagbogbo secteur (Bafwagbogbo HZ: Bavadili, Bomili, Bafwaseba, Bafwazio, Singamwambe, Bafwambongo, Bafwangobi, Bavandomo, Bafwangbogo, Bafwagamia) on the Bafwasende-Banalia/Wamba side
zones.evidence: Northern secteur with artisanal gold-mining zones (e.g. around Bomili) where FARDC/police are posted near mining sites and armed bandits/Mai-Mai Simba elements have occasionally been reported; no known armed-group territorial control. Not verified against 2026 reporting: web research was unavailable for this run (search budget exhausted, search engines and news sites egress-blocked).

zones.description: Opienge secteur (Opienge Centre, Nyasi, Bakoroy, Balobe, Nyekese) in the south toward Maiko National Park and Lubutu/Lubero
zones.evidence: Opienge borders the Maiko park, historically a Mai-Mai Simba (Lumumba/Manu factions) stronghold; the groups live in the forest and gold-mining camps and have raided villages, while the secteur centres retain police and administration and FARDC operate in the area. Southern villages (Balobe) are the least certain. Not verified against 2026 reporting: web research was unavailable for this run (search budget exhausted, search engines and news sites egress-blocked).
